# Security and Authorization Requirements Checklist: Basic Authentication and Authorization

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, clarity, and completeness of the authentication, session, and ownership requirements before implementation
**Created**: 2026-10-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are trust boundaries, sensitive data, and abuse cases documented for this feature as Constitution VI requires? [Completeness, Plan research.md]
- [ ] CHK002 Are password policy requirements for operator-set passwords defined beyond minimum length (maximum length, character set, breached-password handling)? [Gap, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK003 Are initial-credential handling requirements defined for the default owner in every environment (development, test, production)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for password reset when the only owner forgets their password? [Gap, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK005 Are session requirements defined for all lifecycle events (create, refresh, idle expiry, absolute expiry, revoke on disable, sign-out)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements specified for what happens to a user's tree data if the owning account is disabled or removed? [Gap, Spec §FR-010, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK007 Are security event logging requirements specific about which fields are recorded and which are prohibited? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is "temporary lockout" quantified for both the per-account and per-source limits, including the source limit's threshold and window? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "a modern, deliberately slow, salted one-way scheme" specified measurably enough to be verified (for example, minimum work factor)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "indistinguishable" for not-found versus not-owned responses defined to cover status, body, and timing? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "not readable by page scripts" tied to a specific, checkable cookie attribute requirement? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "the same generic message" for failed sign-in defined for locked and disabled accounts as well as wrong credentials? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "source" in per-source throttling defined (client IP, proxy headers, forwarded address handling)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK014 Do the lockout requirements (FR-004) and the generic-failure requirement (FR-003) agree on what a locked account reveals? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the session lifetime defaults in Assumptions consistent with the 013 cookie and session requirements it references? [Consistency, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK016 Does the tree model in this spec (single owner, `family_trees`) align with 003's planned group and membership model? [Conflict, Plan Cross-Feature Impact]
- [ ] CHK017 Are the "most recently opened tree" and "exactly one tree" behaviours consistent between FR-021 and User Story 3? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021, §US3]
- [ ] CHK018 Are error response requirements consistent with the project error contract in 009? [Consistency, Contract auth-and-trees.md]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK019 Can SC-001 ("100% of requests without a valid session are refused") be objectively verified against an enumerated endpoint list? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK020 Can SC-005 (indistinguishable responses) be measured with a defined comparison method? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the SC-003 "under 15 seconds" target defined with start and end points and test conditions? [Clarity, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK022 Do success criteria cover lockout, session expiry, and disabled-account behaviour, not only ownership and migration? [Coverage, Spec Success Criteria]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for concurrent sessions across devices, including sign-out of all sessions? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for simultaneous edits by the same user in two tabs on different trees? [Coverage, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK025 Are recovery requirements defined for a failed or partially applied migration (rollback, re-run safety)? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements defined for a session that expires while a save is in flight, including what happens to unsaved changes? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK027 Are requirements defined for direct, non-UI requests (scripts, bookmarked API URLs) as well as browser flows? [Coverage, Spec §US3]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK028 Are username normalization and uniqueness rules defined for look-alike or Unicode characters? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements defined for oversized or malformed login input (length limits, encoding)? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK030 Is behaviour specified when the seeded default owner already exists with a different password, or its environment values change? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK031 Is behaviour defined for deleting a user's last remaining tree or the tree currently open in another session? [Gap, Spec §FR-020]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK032 Are accessibility requirements for error and lockout messages (announcement to assistive technology, focus management) specified? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK033 Are performance requirements for per-request session and ownership checks stated in the spec, not only the plan? [Gap, Plan Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK034 Are availability requirements defined for session-store or database outages during sign-in (fail closed, user message)? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK035 Are requirements defined to prevent secrets, passwords, and session identifiers from appearing in request logs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §FR-016]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK036 Is the assumption that CSRF is handled by SameSite cookies alone validated, including for any non-`lax` browser behaviour? [Assumption, Spec Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK037 Is the dependency on 013's cookie policy documented with the required behaviour if 013 is not yet implemented? [Dependency, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK038 Is the single-instance assumption for the per-source limiter documented and bounded? [Assumption, Plan research.md]
- [ ] CHK039 Is the future-method requirement (FR-017) specific enough to tell whether a later Google, Apple, or email+OTP design would satisfy it? [Measurability, Spec §FR-017, §SC-006]

## Traceability

- [ ] CHK040 Does every functional requirement map to at least one task and every success criterion to a verification approach? [Traceability, tasks.md]

## Notes

- Defaults used: security/authorization focus, standard depth, reviewer (PR) audience.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
